official.deadline_note: The page publishes no application deadline; scholarship recipients are notified by the university via email before July 31 of the year of admission.
official.status_note: The page (last updated February 2024) publishes no current application window or round status.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Tsinghua publishes the coverage as: 'Tuition fees; Free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy; Stipend; Comprehensive medical [insurance]'.
benefits: Free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy
eligibility: Citizens of countries other than the PRC who are committed to the nuclear industry for the benefit of society, and in good health
Holders of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in nuclear engineering, nuclear technology applications, mechanics, energy, chemical engineering or physics, with strong capability of scientific research
Proficiency in English (spoken, written and reading), with a valid certificate of language proficiency
Under the age of 35 when applying for a Master's program; under 40 for a doctoral program
Those with work experience in nuclear or related fields will be given priority consideration
requirements: Pre-admission from the Department of Engineering Physics or the Institute of Nuclear and New Energy Technology at Tsinghua, meeting department requirements for a recommendation
Completion of the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System application when informed by the pre-admitted department
selection_criteria: Assessment and decision by the China Atomic Energy Authority, the Ministry of Education of the PRC and the China Scholarship Council
Priority consideration for applicants with work experience in nuclear or related fields
coverage: Free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy
application_method: Pre-admission: apply online at https://yzbm.tsinghua.edu.cn/intlLogin to the Department of Engineering Physics or the Institute of Nuclear and New Energy Technology
Complete the System Application in the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System (studyinchina.csc.edu.cn) when informed by the pre-admitted department
official.application_route: Secure pre-admission from one of the two eligible Tsinghua departments through the international portal, then complete the CSC system application on the department's invitation.
official.citizenship_residency: Citizens of countries other than the PRC who are committed to the nuclear industry
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Nuclear-related majors at the Department of Engineering Physics (Nuclear Science and Technology; Physics) or the Institute of Nuclear and New Energy Technology (nine listed research directions)
official.duration: Master's degree: 2-3 years; Doctoral degree: 3-4 years
official.description: The Atomic Energy Scholarship Program of China is jointly initiated by the China Atomic Energy Authority (CAEA) and the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China with the aim of fostering outstanding young talent working in the field of peaceful use of nuclear energy from developing countries.
official.program_type: Master's and doctoral scholarship for nuclear-energy study

applicant_utility.summary: This is a sector-specific Chinese Government Scholarship for nuclear-energy careers, run by Tsinghua together with the China Atomic Energy Authority and the Ministry of Education. Admission runs through two gates: pre-admission from the Department of Engineering Physics or the Institute of Nuclear and New Energy Technology, and only then a CSC system application once the department invites you. The award covers tuition, a dormitory or accommodation subsidy, a stipend and comprehensive medical insurance, but the page publishes no amounts or dates, so you must confirm the current cycle with the departments directly.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Early-career engineers and physicists from outside China committed to a nuclear-industry career who want funded master's or doctoral study.
application_readiness_checklist: Contact the Department of Engineering Physics (gwyjs@tsinghua.edu.cn) or INET (hyyjyk@tsinghua.edu.cn) to confirm the current intake and pre-admission requirements
Prepare a valid English proficiency certificate covering spoken, written and reading proficiency
Document any nuclear-sector work experience - it earns priority consideration
Keep your degree subject aligned with the listed majors (nuclear engineering, mechanics, energy, chemical engineering, physics)
Once pre-admitted, watch for the department's instruction to file the CSC system application
common_rejection_risks: No pre-admission offer from one of the two eligible departments - the scholarship cannot be entered directly
A degree outside the listed STEM majors
Age ceilings: 35 for master's applicants, 40 for doctoral applicants
No valid English language proficiency certificate
Assuming university pre-admission equals the award - CAEA, the MOE and the CSC make the final decision
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Airfare and visa costs are not addressed by the published coverage; application costs and personal spending remain yours.
document_audit: The English certificate must be valid and cover spoken, written and reading proficiency
Pre-admission correspondence is the pivot of the whole process - keep every email from the department
alerts: The official page has not been updated since February 2024 - treat all timing as unconfirmed and verify with the departments
Recipients are notified before 31 July of the admission year, so silence after that date should prompt a follow-up
The award is assessed by CAEA, the MOE and the CSC, so a university pre-admission does not guarantee funding
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Department pre-admission first; on the department's signal you file in the CSC scholarship system; CAEA/MOE/CSC assess and the university emails recipients before 31 July.
